$comment: Exceptions to the rules lint (scripts/security/lint.js). Each entry needs a reason, so loosening access shows up in the pull request diff. Entries that stop matching anything fail the lint and must be removed.

signed-in-function-ignores-caller.sync-score: Placeholder that returns a score from a hash of the given id. It reads no table, so the caller doesn't matter.

ownership-columns-pinned.friend_sharing.friend_id (friend_sharing: friend_sharing controls nothing since 20261111180000; it's kept only for older app builds.
ownership-columns-pinned.notifications.friend_id (notifications_u: Only changes your own notification (the row stays pinned to auth.uid() by user_id), so it can't reach anyone else's data.
